milestone: Shared ordinary/epsilon Taylor recurrence, family-scoped supplied reductions, and connected unequal-mass AMF-seeded physical transport

scope.recurrence: One finite-polynomial channel recurrence serves ordinary AMF/FT, direct epsilon hierarchy and rational root-chart propagation through the existing common continuation engine. Independent dense rational-series reference checks noncommuting M0/M1/M2 at complex centers.
scope.scoped_tables: Exact original family identity, namespaces, ordered slots, dimension and domain guards; existing native graph expansion/application retained. Seven focused regressions cover actual derivative closure, AMF boundary evaluation and rejected incompatible/incomplete tables. No new codec or native arity restriction.
scope.multimass: Connected two-loop sunset, masses squared (1,2,0) to (3/2,5/2,0), targets111 and211, through epsilon0. Native RustRed physical derivative closure, automatic AMF source, checked physical transport, target projection, fresh direct AMF comparison and exact populated cache hit.20-digit mixed scale (absolute near zero), without supplied master values.
scope.native_owners: Symbolica algebra/polynomials/MPFR; existing Linnet reduction DAG owner and HEPKit graph/tensor APIs unchanged.

retained_failures.reason: Projected-target verified_digits is u32 rather than Option<u32>; corrected assertion and focused test passed. Library unchanged.

precursor_pilot.scope: Earlier 04f712 archive established the unequal-mass candidate before adding the production regression; final focused gate uses the new shared recurrence.

provenance.process_scope: Native Rust process, including its threads; no child executables are launched by this probe.

limitations: Full AMFlow/DiffExp parity is not complete.
